component.name: PDF
component.summary: Read, fill in and sign PDF files

description.p: PDF opens PDF files and lets you highlight text, draw and type on pages, fill in forms and sign them. Pages are drawn by Poppler.
Signatures are drawn, typed or made from a picture, and kept in your keyring on this PC. Save a signed copy writes a new file and leaves the original as it was. Nothing is sent anywhere.
